# Modernized PPR Implementation

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Melissa** (1/14/2022):

**PPR Go-live will take place January 25th, 2022.**

PPR currently available through BC OnLine will be turned off January 24th, at 5:00 PM PST. Drafts will not be migrated into the new system. We advise completion of any drafts prior to this time. PPR available through the new modernized Registry, and the PPR API, will be available January 25th at 6:00 AM PST.

To monitor version history see the API Version History section at the bottom of [this page.](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/ppr-api)

Future releases will also be shared through the API Release Management section on [this page.](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/apis-summary)
